description: This file defines the Regex class in the Composer Pcre namespace, providing static methods for regex matching, replacing, and related operations, wrapping PHP's preg_* functions with additional result classes.

classes.name: Regex
classes.description: Provides static methods for regex operations, acting as a wrapper around PHP's preg functions within the Composer Pcre namespace.

methods.name: isMatch
methods.description: Checks if the pattern matches the subject string starting at the given offset.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Performs a regex match and returns a MatchResult object.

methods.name: matchStrictGroups
methods.description: Performs a strict regex match with non-null groups, returning a MatchStrictGroupsResult or throwing if nulls are encountered.

methods.name: matchWithOffsets
methods.description: Runs preg_match with PREG_OFFSET_CAPTURE, returning a MatchWithOffsetsResult.

methods.name: matchAll
methods.description: Performs a global regex match, returning a MatchAllResult.

methods.name: matchAllStrictGroups
methods.description: Performs a strict global regex match with non-null groups, returning a MatchAllStrictGroupsResult.

methods.name: matchAllWithOffsets
methods.description: Runs preg_match_all with offsets, returning a MatchAllWithOffsetsResult.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Performs a regex replacement, returning a ReplaceResult.

methods.name: replaceCallback
methods.description: Performs a regex replacement with a callback, returning a ReplaceResult.

methods.name: replaceCallbackStrictGroups
methods.description: Performs a callback-based replacement with strict non-null groups.

methods.name: replaceCallbackArray
methods.description: Performs callback replacements for multiple patterns.
